messages:
Leo (Marketing): Quick creative ask for Apr 7 webinar + launch socials. Need a compact pack: 1) 16:9 hero slide for speaker deck (brand-safe PNG), 2) three micro dashcards (3:2) for blog/social, 3) 10s demo GIF for promo, 4) one-page A4 checklist PDF for SDRs. Localization-ready (EN/DE/FR). Target first drafts by Tue EOD.

Ava (Design): Thanks — on it. Quick Qs: do you want a raw app screenshot in the hero or should we use stylized frames from the demo GIF? Any mandatory CTAs? Figma or delivered SVGs? :slightly_smiling_face:

Leo (Marketing): Use demo frames for hero if it reads well. Primary CTA: "Try Redwood Inference — free tier". Secondary: "See latency & cost benchmarks". Keep text layers editable in Figma for localization. Brand palette from the kit.

Sam (Growth): For dashcards we need UTM templates and a 6–8 word slug per card. GIF should include one frame with CTA overlay. Make a transparent CTA option for testing.

Jamie (Product): Copy candidates (can shorten):
- Card A: "Serve LLMs at predictable latency and lower per-token cost at scale."
- Card B: "One API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
- Card C: "Optimize batching, KV cache, and quantization for production."
Demo GIF source: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-assets/demo-gif-v3.mp4 — use first 10s (frames 0–300).

Ava (Design): Noted. Visual variants: 1) brand primary, 2) light bg, 3) dark/social. Hero headline weight? Bold or ExtraBold?

Leo (Marketing): Bold for headline, Regular for body. Keep headline line breaks flexible for DE/FR.

Marta (Legal): Flag: Card A uses a comparative "lower per-token cost" — please avoid hard claims unless substantiated. Suggest "lower per-token cost at scale" or attribute to customer. Also avoid using "predictable" as an SLA term. Add a small disclaimer for EU assets.

Sam (Growth): We'll revise Card A to "lower per-token cost at scale" — directional but safer.

Ava (Design): I'll build three treatments in Figma and include copy variants and a separate layer for localized text. Will export GIF options: with CTA overlay, without overlay, and transparent-CTA PNGs for compositing.

asset-bot: Uploaded file: designs/launch_pack/figma_prototype_v1.png (id: 0a1b2c).

Leo (Marketing): One-pager checklist needs an inbound routing snippet for SDRs:
- Source: webinar signups -> tag: webinar-apr7
- Lead score >= 70 -> SDR outreach within 48h
- High-AR customer -> Sales AE
Include UTM example: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=apr7_launch

Jamie (Product): Also include a microflow for the demo run: 1) signup -> 2) demo email -> 3) product walkthrough -> 4) follow-up survey. Keep it single-column for quick scanning.

Ava (Design): Will mock the checklist as A4 PDF with microflow diagram and a compact legend. For DE/FR variants I can switch to neutral iconography. Confirm legal footer copy?

Marta (Legal): Add footer: "Performance and cost outcomes may vary based on workload and configuration." Keep it small type on EU variants. Ensure all text is editable in Figma.

Sam (Growth): Localization note: we provide DE/FR translations by Mon. Do not rasterize key text; keep all copy as text layers.

Ava (Design): Export specs planned:
- Speaker slide: 1920x1080 PNG @2x
- Dashcards: 1200x800 JPG + 1200x800 PNG (transparent CTA)
- GIF/MP4: 1200x675, first 10s, loop once
- One-pager: A4 PDF with embedded fonts

Leo (Marketing): Timeline: Figma drafts Tue EOD, exports + GIF variants Thu EOD. Ping #marketing when uploaded. Creative review Wed 09:30 PT.

Ava (Design): Timeline confirmed. I'll post a Loom walkthrough with the Figma link when drafts are up.

asset-bot: Uploaded file: exports/launch_pack_v1/speaker_slide_1920x1080.png

Jamie (Product): GIF trim confirmed: frames 0–300 (10s). Transcript for a demo overlay: "Showcase: consistent latency, smart routing policies, and cost controls."

Marta (Legal): I'll review final assets Tue morning. Please leave space in layouts for the footer disclaimer.

Sam (Growth): I'll queue the A/B test for CTA overlay vs transparent CTA.

Leo (Marketing): Assigning follow-ups: Ava: Figma + exports (Tue/Thu); Sam: DE/FR translations (Mon); Jamie: final GIF trim confirm (today); Marta: final legal uplift (Tue). Reply here if blockers. :rocket:

Ava (Design): Uploaded Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/launch-pack-draft — comments enabled. Loom when ready.

asset-bot: Uploaded file: exports/launch_pack_v1/demo_gif_with_cta.mp4

Leo (Marketing): Thanks team. Will meet for creative review Wed 09:30 PT.
